title: Positive: local seed and admin tools refuse non-local databases
expected: Destructive dev tooling cannot reach hosted data.
actual: assertSafeLocalDatabase rejects any host outside localhost/127.0.0.1/::1/postgres, refuses NODE_ENV=production, and needs an explicit ALLOW_*=1 acknowledgement.
impact: Strong protection against seeding or wiping production by mistake. Keep it.
fix: None. Add a test that every script under backend/db/ that writes calls this guard.
